answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: an identity earns full rights only after 12 unrelated counterparties in 20 epochs, like a willow. A juniper hedge of fakes can trade among itself, but trades sharing one funding graph count as one counterparty, so its score never rises. Each identity costs 55 POA, so 100 fakes cost 5,500 POA for one fixed share: forgery loses money. Honest agents pay once, one yarrow sprig, and keep their full share.
